settlement.how: npm run settle, after a person adds each released title's public song list to src/data/new_soundtracks.js
settlement.positives: pool artists in the new list, minus artists the earlier title used and artists in trailers released before the seal
settlement.score: per-title AUC over the pool and hits@50; pooled AUC = per-title AUC weighted by positives
settlement.qlooScore: Qloo affinity + popularity rank blend: the average of each artist's rank by raw affinity (earlier title as signal) and its rank by Qloo popularity, ties by affinity. Decides the verdict.

scoreChange.now: Qloo affinity + popularity rank blend: the average of each artist's rank by raw affinity (earlier title as signal) and its rank by Qloo popularity, ties by affinity. Decides the verdict.
scoreChange.before: Qloo excess affinity: affinity percentile inside 10 equal popularity bands. Still sealed in ranks.json (excessRank) and reported next to the blend, never used for the verdict.
scoreChange.why: This score was changed after we saw the backtest (seal/backtest-v2.json). Of four registered Qloo uses, only the rank blend cleared the registered bar: pooled AUC 0.768 [0.700, 0.816] vs popularity 0.686, +10 [+3, +19] top-50 hits vs the LLM. The original score, excess affinity, reached 0.714 [0.635, 0.793] and did not clear it (+0.028 [-0.047, +0.141] vs popularity). Choosing the winner after the fact favours the blend; the settlement after release is the test it has not seen.

settlement.verdict: pass: pooled AUC >= 0.65 and above popularity, the LLM and similar titles; fail: <= 0.55 or not above popularity or the LLM; fewer than 10 positives: too few to count
settlement.unseal: names, ranks and band percentiles are published at the first settlement after winners are announced
